Chapter 698: Chapter 7: The Transformation of the Mysterious Gourd (Please Subscribe)

Without any enhancement, the Door to the Myriad Realms operated on its own, accumulating World-Breaking Origin Force at a pace of one strand every three hundred and thirty-three days.

The Eternal Spatial Rift in Alien Battlefield B0001 increased the accumulation speed of World-Breaking Origin Force to one strand every one hundred and fifty days.

And now—

Lin Yuan clearly felt that the absorption speed of the World-Breaking Origin Force had once again ascended a level.

It reached an unprecedented ninety days per strand.

In other words, every ninety days that passed in the Main World, it could accumulate one strand of World-Breaking Origin Force.

...

In one year, it would accumulate four strands; in ten years, forty strands; in one hundred years, four hundred strands.

“With the World-Breaking Origin Force I now possess, already exceeding two hundred strands, wouldn’t staying in this Large Alien Battlefield for a while enable me to easily surpass a thousand strands?”

Lin Yuan’s spirit was elated.

The World-Breaking Origin Force was linked to the operation of the Door to the Myriad Realms, the more the better.

“The tenth traversal… Wait until my strength hits a bottleneck, then undertake the tenth traversal.” Lin Yuan’s consciousness plunged deeper into his mind, gazing at that majestic and magnificent Door to the Myriad Realms.

At present, Lin Yuan had just entered Tier 10 and was comprehending the Fusion Rules pathways on the black star, his strength in its fastest period of growth.

Traverse now? That would be somewhat wasteful.

Where else to cultivate if not in cultivation? For Lin Yuan, traversing worlds was no different from being in the Main World.

“Continue cultivating,” Lin Yuan closed his eyes.

The improved speed of World-Breaking Origin Force accumulation only required Lin Yuan to stay underneath the Eternal Spatial Rift.

There was no need for mental engagement, Lin Yuan could completely turn to comprehend the secret techniques of the rules.

…..

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan was practicing Enlightenment.

Suddenly.

“Xia Qin Supreme Being is looking for me?” Lin Yuan split a sliver of will, connected to the Virtual World, and entered the personal world of the Supreme Being.

“Supreme Being,” Lin Yuan bowed slightly.

Xia Qin Supreme Being had helped him numerous times, and showing respect to a Twelfth Rank Ultimate Being was only natural.

“Lin Yuan.” Xia Qin Supreme Being looked at Lin Yuan with a smile and asked, “Have you passed the test of the Heritage Star and seen the Fusion Rules pathway guide?”

“Heritage Star?”Lin Yuan instantly understood that the ‘Heritage Star’ referred to by Xia Qin Supreme Being was the black star.

It didn’t surprise Lin Yuan that Xia Qin Supreme Being was aware of the black star’s existence, as anything the three goddesses knew, Xia Qin Supreme Being could also know.

Lin Yuan had uploaded the information about the black star to the Goddess of Wisdom and thus had anticipated this day.

“I have seen it.”

“And I’m currently contemplating it,” Lin Yuan replied truthfully.

Through the information about the black star provided by the Goddess of Wisdom.

Lin Yuan could guess that human civilization also possessed a similar Heritage Star.

“How is it?”

“And the Fusion Rules pathway guide, how far have you reached?” Xia Qin Supreme Being asked with slight curiosity.

“Fourth Realm,” Lin Yuan stated directly.

“A Fourth Realm pathway guide?” Xia Qin Supreme Being looked surprised.

He had thought it would only be a Second or Third Realm pathway guide, which is why the Goddess of Wisdom ended up offering five hundred million merit points.

But a Fourth Realm? That meant the value of the black star exceeded five hundred million by tenfold or even hundredfold.

“Your luck, it’s unparalleled,” Xia Qin Supreme Being couldn’t help but express his admiration.

Chancing upon a Heritage Star worth tens or even hundreds of billions of merit points just by traveling.

Lin Yuan couldn’t help nodding.

Indeed.

Over the past more than one hundred years, having undergone nine traversals and opened up the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, the total merit points he had reaped were also in the hundreds of millions.

Not even close to the real value of the black star.

This was the chance encounter, the main reason most Evolvers were keen on venturing out, because one critical opportunity could greatly enhance their foundation.

Of course.

No matter how great the opportunity, it needed to be built on one’s own strength.

If the discoverer of the black star wasn’t Lin Yuan but an ordinary human citizen.

They absolutely couldn’t have a fair trade with human civilization.

It was precisely because Lin Yuan, the strongest genius in human civilization’s history, that he obtained the qualifications to negotiate.

“How do you plan to dispose of this Heritage Star?” Xia Qin Supreme Being asked.

“Please advise, Supreme Being,” Lin Yuan said at once.

“My suggestion is, lease it out,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said with a smile.

“A Fourth Realm Fusion Rules pathway guide is enough to drive our human civilization’s Tenth Rank Evolvers mad, they would be willing to pay a huge price to come in and comprehend it,” Xia Qin Supreme Being explained.

Regarding this suggestion, he had no ulterior motives, but rather was considering the maximization of Lin Yuan’s interests from his perspective.

Lin Yuan can only enter twelve doors on the black star at most, a maximum of twelve times.

What about after those twelve times? The black star wouldn’t be destroyed; leaving it idle and leasing it out to create more benefit was the best choice.

“What does the Supreme Being think the ‘rent’ should be?” Lin Yuan wasn’t opposed to leasing out the black star.

Mainly, whether the price was satisfactory to him.

“One billion,” Xia Qin Supreme Being stated calmly.

“One billion?” Lin Yuan blinked in surprise.

“One billion merit points for one opportunity to enter and comprehend,” Xia Qin Supreme Being clarified.

“One billion merit points?” Lin Yuan took a deep breath.

He had been wondering what unit Xia Qin Supreme Being’s ‘one billion’ referred to, Cosmic Crystals or something else.

The result was merit points?

Merit points of human civilization, one of the most stable currencies in the Cosmic Starry Skies, even above Cosmic Crystals, could purchase many restricted-level resources within human civilization.

Merely for one chance to enter and comprehend, demanding a sky-high price of one billion merit points, Lin Yuan felt somewhat reluctant.

“`

“One hundred million merit points for one contemplation session isn’t high,” explained Xia Qin Supreme Being. “You should know that the guidepath within that heritage star reaches up to the Fourth Realm.”

“Every evolver who enters to comprehend will elevate their fusion rules to the Fourth Realm before leaving.”

“This takes up a considerable amount of time, and the final gain is a Fourth Realm fusion rule? Even within the Tier 11 level, that wouldn’t be considered weak.”

“Yes,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Even so, the dark planet had a total of twelve black gates, theoretically capable of accommodating up to twelve evolvers at the same time.

One hundred million merit points per person, twelve people would make it twelve billion merit points.

Such a colossal sum of merit points could easily elevate an ordinary citizen to the heights of a Ninth-Level Citizen.

And this is only the ‘rent’ for the first round.

Once this batch of contemplators leave, wouldn’t the rent for the next batch come in?

“However, Supreme Being, I think I will wait until I step into Tier 11 before I rent it out,” Lin Yuan contemplated and then said.

Although the rent was tempting, Lin Yuan likewise valued his own advancement.

Other evolvers, even if they possessed this dark planet, would have limited energy and could at most contemplate one or two.

But Lin Yuan, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, could completely comprehend all twelve pillar-level fusion rules.

And during this period, Lin Yuan would not let other evolvers come in to contemplate, otherwise if he wanted to comprehend the fusion rule guidepath that others were contemplating, he would have to wait for them to finish.

“No problem,” Xia Qin Supreme Being said nonchalantly.

What of it?

In the eyes of Xia Qin Supreme Being, with Lin Yuan’s talent, stepping into Tier 11 wouldn’t take too long.

And suggesting Lin Yuan to rent out the dark planet would also enhance the overall strength of human civilization.

With every additional Fourth Realm fusion rule evolver, the overall foundation of human civilization would be improved.

And Lin Yuan would gain considerable benefits as well.

It was a win-win situation.

…

After leaving Xia Qin Supreme Being’s personal space.

Lin Yuan disconnected from the virtual world and sat in the Star Lord’s Great Hall on the Milky Way Main Star.

“Twelve billion merit points?”

Lin Yuan’s heart was joyous.

As long as he comprehended all twelve fusion rule guidepaths within the dark planet.

He could then rent out the twelve contemplation opportunities of the dark planet.

By then, he would have twelve billion merit points credited to his account.

Even without opening the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter, he would be able to steadily rise to become a Ninth-Level Citizen.

“However, having stepped into the Tenth Rank for so long, which Rare Treasure should I choose?”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts shifted, and he became somewhat conflicted.

The Rare Treasures here refer to the rewards obtained for passing the fifth floor of the Nine Floors Dark Tower in the Demon Jade Space.

Early in his Ninth Rank, Lin Yuan had fully comprehended the Rule of Time, taking time to penetrate through the fifth floor of the Dark Tower.

After all, passing the fifth floor at Ninth Rank, compared to doing so at Tenth Rank and Tier 11, was an entirely different concept.

The Dark Tower’s rewards also depended on the potential of the cultivator.

If one could pass the fifth floor at Ninth Rank, what did that say about their potential?

Therefore.

The final reward list given by the Stone Statue Shen Ji had left Lin Yuan hesitant to decide until now.

There were five Rare Treasures on the reward list.

Lin Yuan could choose only one out of the five.

And these five Rare Treasures, according to the standards of the Main Universe.

They were all Twelve-Star Rare Treasures.

Corresponding to the treasures of the Supreme Being level.

The Eternal Spring that Lin Yuan once immersed himself in was a Twelve-Star Rare Treasure.

It was for this reason that Lin Yuan had not yet decided.

After all, the reward was there; delaying the selection would not make much of a difference.

“Let’s look again.”

After contemplating for a moment, Lin Yuan felt that it was better not to rush.

He would wait until he had practiced for a while longer, determine his needs, and then make the most beneficial choice.

…

Half a year later.

Inner World.

Lin Yuan looked down.

At this moment, the peripheral area of this Inner World was expanding once again.

The direct size of the Inner World had reached 2.33 billion square miles.

That was the limit size the Inner World could achieve after fully absorbing the seven types of liquids in the Mysterious Gourd.

Yes.

Just now.

Lin Yuan had completely absorbed that drop of purple liquid.

“I can feel it; my Inner World has reached some kind of ultimate state,” Lin Yuan silently thought.

After a while.

Lin Yuan’s consciousness left the Inner World.

Returning to the outside.

And then he looked solemnly at the gray-purple gourd in front of him.

Now that he had absorbed all seven types of liquid, what would happen next with this Mysterious Gourd?

With this thought, Lin Yuan held the gourd in his right hand.

As Lin Yuan’s physical body touched the gourd.

This Mysterious Gourd seemed to detect the changes in Lin Yuan.

A torrent of information burst forth from the gourd, exploding in Lin Yuan’s mind.
